objective: GEO workspace beside AI builder, serving existing managed sites
requirements: Site-isolated persistent facts, questions, observations, audits and content proposals with optimistic concurrency
Chinese and English interface and separately generated content sharing approved fact identities
Fact evidence URLs, verification dates, expiry and explicit approval
Versioned questions by intent, market and language
Read-only public website diagnostics with SSRF protection and explicit limits
Import real observations with raw answers, citations, platform, mode, environment and timestamp; failures are not absence
Separate manual consumer observations, grounded API probes, official reports and simulations
Metrics grouped by comparable sampling conditions with raw evidence export; no invented visibility or causal growth claims
Configured real LLM creates question suggestions and evidence-grounded page proposals; no implicit search claim
Review proposals before transferring to the existing page draft and publication workflow
Responsive step interface with accessible forms, empty/error/busy states and unsaved-change protection
Backend authorization, validation, concurrency and isolation tests plus browser end-to-end coverage
Verify release packaging includes the GEO module and deployed runtime works
scope_notes: Initial visibility acquisition supports evidence import; official report APIs and search connectors must be verified before automatic acquisition is enabled
Technical diagnostics do not claim to prove index inclusion or verified bot access
Demonstration sites may test functionality but are not evidence of real business growth

implementation.prompt_management: Existing prompt library, GEO category; three modules per language with versions and snapshots
implementation.observation_acquisition: Operator entry or JSON batch import; real search, grounded API and simulation remain separate
implementation.diagnostics: Pinned public IP HTTP fetch, HTML, robots, sitemap and response indexing headers; WAF/verified bots and index inclusion require external verification
implementation.publishing: Reviewed proposal appends a sanitized section to existing page draft; existing preview, publication journal and restore remain authoritative

verification_commands: KF_E2E_REAL_AI_BASE=<configured-base> KF_E2E_REAL_AI_PROFILE=<real-profile> npm run test:geo:live --prefix tests/ui
